p.src: Johnny Anton’s interview is not a blackboard lecture, but it does have a clear operating logic. In these notes, we keep the claims source-conscious. Johnny’s stories remain stories, his business claims remain attributed claims, and the equations are compact reconstructions of the loops and mechanisms described in the conversation.
